title: Counter tape action
statement: For natural numbers $k_K,k_W$, an optional optional Boolean $w$, a head movement $d\\in\\{-1,0,1\\}$, and an optional successor state $q$, define an action on $k_K+1+k_W$ work tapes over the Boolean alphabet: the input head stays in place, every work tape except the middle tape is left unchanged and stationary, and the middle tape receives write instruction $w$ and moves by $d$. The action emits no output and passes to $q$, halting if $q$ is absent.
hypotheses_covered: An optional optional Boolean write instruction for the middle tape
